<template>
    <v-container class="text-center" v-if="product">
        <v-row density="comfortable">
            <v-col cols="12" md="4" class="mx-auto">
            </v-col>
            <v-col cols="12" md="8" class="mx-auto">
                <v-card class="prodct__card mx-auto pa-4" outlined variant="text" rounded="lg">
                    <v-row>
                        <v-col cols="12" md="4">
                            <v-img color="" height="336" :src="product.thumbnail"/>
                            
                        </v-col>
                    </v-row>
                </v-card>
            </v-col>
        </v-row>
    </v-container>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      product: null,
    }
  },
  async mounted() {
    const productId = this.$route.params.id;
    const res = await fetch('https://dummyjson.com/products/' + productId);
    const data = await res.json();
    this.product = data;
  }
}
</script>
